summary: Battle director: runs the turn loop, resolves AI turns and waits for the player's.
overview: Register combatants — actors self-register — call StartBattle, and it runs the whole loop: rebuilding initiative order each round, resolving AI turns through a brain, and pausing on player-controlled actors until your UI submits an action.
useCases: A tactics encounter where order is decided by a stat.
Mixed parties of player and AI-controlled actors.

params.tuning: Purely presentational — it gives the player time to read what the AI did. Zero makes AI turns instant and hard to follow.

gotchas.title: An actor with no brain is treated as player-controlled
gotchas.body: The loop then waits indefinitely for SubmitPlayerAction. An enemy that freezes the battle is usually one missing its UtilityAIBrain.

gotchas.title: Initiative order is rebuilt each round
gotchas.body: A buff changing initiative mid-battle takes effect next round, not immediately.
